## Corinthians v Vitória: survival fight meets away-day drought

Corinthians host Vitória in the Brasileirão on Monday, 19 October 2026 in São Paulo, with the hosts needing points to stay clear of danger while the visitors chase a first away win of the season. [...] Timão are without Memphis through suspension until 21 October, with Labyad and Kayke sidelined. Nêgo also miss suspended centre-back Cacá until 21 October and have defensive injuries to Camatunga, Fabiano, Ramon, Edu and Nathan Mendes, while Gabriel Baralhas and Dudu are out.
